$Comment: What the anvil's Enhance ritual rolls onto a placed weapon: the station's Picks draws from this pool,
each draw one entry picked by Weight, its Points rolled between Min and Max in whole percent points.
The first four are the stats and ranges MMO Skill Tree's own weapon pool (Mmo_Enhance_Weapon) writes,
so a weapon enhanced at the anvil and one enhanced with /mmoitemenhance carry the same stats.
KillYield is a weapon pool's luck: points on the chance of a kill's bonus find, the combat side of
GatherYield. TrackGain raises the XP every skill earns while the weapon is held.
Retune a range or a weight and the next roll uses it. Add an entry and every anvil roll can draw it.
Name: AnvilWeaponPool
